messages:
naveen (partnerships): EdgeCore (hw SI) asked what to upload for marketplace listing. They
sked whether firmware can be in the same ZIP as pen test artifacts or if HSM attestation is required separately.

lio (security): Firmware requires special handling. If included, it must be encrypted and attested (sha256 + signer cert). Prefer separate HSM attestation package when keys are involved. NDA first.

hannah (solutions): We can provide a KMS-encrypted prefix. Proposed layout: /edgecore-1771112223/raw (reports), /edgecore-1771112223/firmware (encrypted blobs), /edgecore-1771112223/attestations. Presigns per-file.

tara (compliance): Required artifacts: SOC2 Type II PDF, pen-test report + SOW, network topology, data flow, vendor questionnaire, manifest.json with checksums and remediation_owner. If firmware present include firmware_signer and cert_chain fields.

naveen (partnerships): POC is a.choi@edgecore-hw.com. They propose pen window May 1-5 with witness May 3. Will confirm after NDA.

lio (security): Once NDA signed we'll create restricted bucket and issue presigns (24h for pen vendor). Redaction will remove customer PII/internal hostnames. We'll produce a redaction report.

hannah (solutions): Created bucket template and IAM role (no Delete). Example presign: aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/edgecore-1771112223/firmware/fw.bin --expires-in 86400

vault-bot: kms-key-created arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/edgecore-1771112223 (restricted)

tara (compliance): Manifest keys: vendor_name, contact_email, artifact_types, sha256_map (filename->sha256), scope_start, scope_end, nda_signed, firmware_signer, cert_chain_path, remediation_owner.

naveen (partnerships): I'll send NDA and intro, ask them to include remediation SLA in SOW. Will update thread when uploaded.

lio (security): Also require pen vendor contact and timezone to lock witness date. I'll triage CVEs within our SLA once report received.

hannah (solutions): Lifecycle tag added: marketplace:pending-edgecore-1771112223. Retention for raw uploads: 180 days.

naveen (partnerships): Thanks all  will follow up with calendar invites and announce internal embargo plan. :handshake:
